answer: Weight each identity by counterparty entropy: an agent earns full rate only when its task counterparties are many and mutually unrelated, so its transaction graph spreads outward. A sybil fleet trading only among its own clones forms one dense low-entropy knot - the harbor where fake ships all moor together - and the ledger caps that knot as a single voice. Honest agents whose work runs across a varied ridge of unrelated peers keep full weight; velvet-glove collusion buys nothing but shared dilution.
